items.source: paramMap - parameters associated with the name specified while declaring the SqlParameters. Primitive parameters must be represented by their Object wrapper type. The ordering of parameters is not significant since they are supplied in a SqlParameterMap which is an implementation of the Map interface.
items.translation: paramMap - 与声明 SqlParameters 时指定的名称关联的参数。基本类型参数必须由其包装器对象类型表示。参数的顺序无关紧要，因为它们是通过 SqlParameterMap 提供的，而 SqlParameterMap 是 Map 接口的一个实现。

items.source: paramMap - parameters associated with the name specified while declaring the SqlParameters. Primitive parameters must be represented by their Object wrapper type. The ordering of parameters is not significant.

items.source: paramMap - a Map of parameter name to parameter object, matching named parameters specified in the SQL statement. Ordering is not significant.
items.translation: paramMap - 一个将参数名映射到参数对象的 Map，与 SQL 语句中指定的命名参数相匹配。顺序不重要。

items.source: Subclasses must implement the newRowMapper(Object[], Map) method to provide an object that can extract the results of iterating over the ResultSet created during the execution of the query.
items.translation: 子类必须实现newRowMapper(Object[], Map)方法，以提供一个能够提取在查询执行期间创建的ResultSet迭代结果的对象。

items.source: Like all RdbmsOperation classes that ship with the Spring Framework, SqlQuery instances are thread-safe after their initialization is complete. That is, after they are constructed and configured via their setter methods, they can be used safely from multiple threads.
items.translation: 与随 Spring Framework 提供的所有 `RdbmsOperation` 类一样，在初始化完成后，`SqlQuery` 实例是线程安全的。也就是说，在通过其 setter 方法构建和配置之后，它们可以从多个线程中安全使用。

items.source: This class provides a number of public execute methods that are analogous to the different convenient JDO query execute methods. Subclasses can either rely on one of these inherited methods, or can add their own custom execution methods, with meaningful names and typed parameters (definitely a best practice). Each custom query method will invoke one of this class's untyped query methods.
items.translation: 该类提供了若干公共的 `execute` 方法，它们类似于不同的便捷 JDO 查询执行方法。子类可以依赖这些继承的方法之一，也可以添加具有有意义名称和类型化参数的自定义执行方法（这绝对是最佳实践）。每个自定义查询方法都将调用此类的某个未类型化查询方法。

items.source: The DataSource and SQL must be supplied before compilation and use.
items.translation: 在编译和使用之前，必须提供DataSource和SQL。

items.source: Subclasses must implement this method to extract an object per row, to be returned by the execute method as an aggregated List.
items.translation: 子类必须实现此方法以按行提取对象，以便由 execute 方法作为聚合的 List 返回。

items.source: Generic object finder method, used by all other findObject methods. Object finder methods are like EJB entity bean finders, in that it is considered an error if they return more than one result.
